# Intuitech Fantasy (league-2) -- Saturday Briefing, Week 2

## Source and freshness

**Live, and this time genuinely full.** `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` returned **246 Week 2 rows across all 32 teams** this run -- a real jump from Wednesday's 11 rows covering only Thursday's two teams (BUF, DET). Cross-checked by exact player ID (not name substring matching, which can silently miss or misfire) against the full Week 2 table: **exactly one of this roster's 15 players has a live tag.**

`season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` returns **Week 2**, confirmed against the schedule: Thursday's opener (DET @ BUF, final 41-31) is done, and all 13 Sunday games plus the Monday nighter (NYG @ LA) still show no score. This is a genuine mid-week-2 report with most of the week still ahead, not a stale detection.

FantasyPros was skipped (no API key). Rotowire and ESPN news/injury are proxy-blocked (403), same as every prior run -- every number below is the in-house tier with availability and calibration applied, run through `generate_report.py` end-to-end. The rolling-volume/Vegas blend (`blend.py`) was run with `--skip-blend` again, per the unresolved finding from the last two briefings; not re-tested this run to stay inside budget.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected pts | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Jaxson Dart | @LAR (Mon 8:15p) | **16.85** | 95.1% | 17.72 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @KC (Sun SNF 8:20p) | **14.71** | 92.2% | 15.95 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs CLE (Sun 1:00p) | **12.58** | 92.2% | 13.64 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @ARI (Sun 4:25p) | **14.34** | 94.8% | 15.13 |
| WR | Tee Higgins | @HOU (Sun 1:00p) | **6.33** | 82.1% | 7.71 |
| TE | Harold Fannin Jr. | vs TB (Sun 1:00p) | **4.59** | 91.5% | 5.02 |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | @LAR (Mon 8:15p) | **9.83** | 92.2% | 10.66 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | @BUF -- **FINAL** | **5.30 (actual)** | played | 5.30 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | vs LV (Sun 4:05p) | **5.44** | 97.5% | 5.58 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | @TEN (Sun 1:00p) | **4.98** | 100% | 4.98 |
| **Total** | | | **94.95** | | |

Bench (expected-points order): Matthew Stafford QB (10.00 -- no usable slot behind Dart), Josh Downs WR (6.00), Drake London WR (5.92), Quentin Johnston WR (4.49), Brock Bowers TE (0.14 -- see below).

**Be decisive: nine of these ten calls are unchanged and unambiguous.** The one thing worth a second look is Jameson Williams' row -- his game is over, not upcoming (see below).

## Jameson Williams already played

DET @ BUF kicked off Thursday night and is final (BUF won 41-31). Williams caught 2 of his targets for 33 yards -- **5.30 points under league-2 scoring**, a real result, not a projection. Whatever this slot was set to before 8:15p ET Thursday is now locked in; there is nothing left to decide here today. His row above carries the actual stat line so the lineup total is honest, not a phantom pre-game number. That swap (5.30 actual vs. Wednesday's 6.18 projection) accounts for the entire 0.88-point drop in tonight's total versus Wednesday's 95.83 -- nothing else in the lineup moved.

## Bowers: real tag, same call, more confidence

Brock Bowers now carries a genuine live Week 2 designation for the first time this season: **Doubtful, knee, Limited Participation in Practice.** Wednesday's briefing had him at an artifact 81.4% P(play) because no LV rows existed yet in the feed; with the real tag in, the fitted availability model puts him at **2.4%** (the historical base rate for a Doubtful designation is 1.15% across 262 cases, so this is squarely in range) and **0.14 expected points**. This doesn't flip anything -- Fannin was already the start on Wednesday's numbers -- but it moves the reasoning from "the model doesn't have data yet" to "the model has seen a real Doubtful tag and priced it correctly." His if-he-plays number (5.57) still edges Fannin's (5.02), so if LV upgrades him before Sunday's ~2:35p ET inactives list (LV @ LAC, 4:05p ET), it's worth one more look -- but Doubtful rarely reverses that fast.

## Changes since Wednesday

**None in the lineup itself** -- same ten slots, same players. What changed is the *evidence* behind two of those calls: full injury coverage returned (Bowers' tag went from absent-data placeholder to a confirmed real designation), and Jameson Williams' Thursday game resolved from a projection to an actual result.

## Watch list

- **Brock Bowers** -- Doubtful/knee/Limited is real now, not a placeholder. Final word comes with LV's inactives list Sunday afternoon. Doesn't change today's call.
- **Higgins / Downs / London / Johnston** -- still bunched (4.49-6.33 expected), no live tags for any of them as of this pull. Ordering unchanged from Wednesday. Early (1:00p ET) and late (4:05p ET) Sunday inactives lists are the next checkpoints.

## Opponent notes

- **Jameson Williams (DET @ BUF)** -- game over, see above.
- **Jonathan Taylor / Josh Downs (IND @ KC)** -- Sunday Night Football, 8:20p ET. Last chance to react to the rest of Sunday's news before that slot locks.
- **Jaxson Dart / Cam Skattebo (NYG @ LA)**, with bench QB Stafford on the other side of that game -- Monday Night Football, 8:15p ET, the very last decision point of the week.

## Byes ahead

**None in the next two weeks (weeks 3-4).** The next cluster is still **Week 6** -- Tee Higgins (CIN) and Jameson Williams (DET), both in the active lineup mix -- worth starting to plan waiver cover for given only five bench spots and two same-position byes landing together.

## Caveats

- Full Week 2 injury coverage returned this run (246 rows, all 32 teams) -- a real improvement, cross-checked by exact player ID. Only Brock Bowers among this roster has a live tag.
- Jameson Williams' FLEX row is his real Thursday-night result (5.30 pts), not a projection -- accounts for the entire gap between this week's 94.95 total and Wednesday's 95.83.
- Bowers' Doubtful/knee/Limited tag is new and real; doesn't change the TE call (Fannin already ahead) but replaces a data-absence artifact with a genuine read.
- blend.py was run with --skip-blend again per the unresolved finding from the last two briefings; not re-tested this run.
- FantasyPros (no key), Rotowire, and ESPN news/injury remain unavailable in this sandbox -- in-house tier only.
- Only this briefing file and the manifest entry were written to the repository.
